blocks.content: **回** (かい) counts the number of times something occurs. Pair it with a time frame and a number to express how often an action happens.

rows.english: once a month (一度 = one time, softer)

rows.japanese: 週に三回ジムに行きます。
rows.romaji: Shū ni sankai jimu ni ikimasu.
rows.english: I go to the gym three times a week.

rows.japanese: 一日に二回薬を飲みます。
rows.romaji: Ichinichi ni nikai kusuri wo nomimasu.
rows.english: I take medicine twice a day.

rows.japanese: 月に一度、家族に電話します。
rows.romaji: Tsuki ni ichido, kazoku ni denwa shimasu.
rows.english: I call my family once a month.

rows.japanese: 年に一回しか会いません。
rows.english: We only meet once a year.

blocks.content: 回 triggers phonetic changes with certain numbers. 一回 (ikkai), 六回 (rokkai), 八回 (hakkai), 十回 (jukkai) : a geminate っ appears before k. You will pick these up naturally from listening; don't memorise the full table upfront.
